label: Proposition 43
title: Limits Voters’ Ability to Raise Revenues for Local Government Services. Legislative Constitutional Amendment.
q: Limits voters’ ability to pass voter-proposed local special taxes by increasing percentage of votes needed to approve such ballot measures from a majority (over 50%) to two-thirds, beginning January 1, 2027. Fiscal Impact: Possibility that local government tax revenues will not go up as much in the future due to a higher vote threshold for certain taxes.
yes: Certain local government taxes would require two-thirds approval by voters.
no: Certain local government taxes could continue to be approved by voters with a majority vote.
